request_id.description: Unique value for every execution. Change it even when repeating the same URL.

start_time.description: Optional HH:MM:SS section start. Must be paired with end_time.

end_time.description: Optional HH:MM:SS section end. Must be paired with start_time.

question.description: The user's analysis question. Stored with the Artifact for downstream analysis.

note.description: Optional operational note. Never put secrets here because this repository is public.
